boards.title: Your First Weekend at University of Alabama in Huntsville, Shared as Cards
boards.description: A low-pressure, under-21-safe sequence for learning the UAH campus, finding a current welcome activity, and ending with a Huntsville walk if transportation works for you.

cards.title: 1. Check the Week of Welcome schedule
cards.subtitle: Start-of-semester campus programs
cards.notes: Use the official schedule to choose one social, educational, or informational program that fits your arrival time and gives you a reason to meet people.
cards.short_summary: Begin with a recurring campus-wide welcome program.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH describes Week of Welcome as a campus-wide set of programs and activities for new and returning students at the start of each semester.
cards.source_title: Week of Welcome | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: See the official schedule for current programs and locations.

cards.title: 2. Make Charger Union your first landmark
cards.subtitle: Campus hub for dining, study space, and events
cards.notes: Walk through the Charger Union after your first program. Use it to orient yourself to a central place for dining, studying, and student events.
cards.short_summary: Establish a practical campus meeting point.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH identifies the Charger Union as the heart of campus life, with dining, study spaces, and student events.
cards.source_title: Life at UAH | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Campus map lists Charger Union as CGU; check building access before entering.

cards.title: 3. Pause for a campus meal at Charger Café
cards.subtitle: Conference Training Center
cards.notes: Use a meal break to practice finding the Conference Training Center and decide which dining option suits your plan. Confirm menus and service before going.
cards.short_summary: Pair lunch with another easy navigation win.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH’s orientation schedule places Charger Café in the Conference Training Center and schedules lunch there.
cards.source_title: Charger Camp Guest Schedule | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Dining requires payment or an eligible campus dining account; verify current hours and menu.

cards.title: 4. Locate your library reset spot
cards.subtitle: M. Louis Salmon Library
cards.notes: Stop in to identify the help desk, group-study options, and MultiMaker Lab. Save the library contact so you can ask about current hours or room access later.
cards.short_summary: Find study support before classes accelerate.
cards.evidence_claim: Salmon Library offers research materials, reference assistance, group study rooms, and the MultiMaker Lab.
cards.source_title: Salmon Library | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: The library reports it is open to the public; verify current building and service hours online.

cards.title: 5. Take in Union Grove Gallery
cards.subtitle: Historic campus gallery and meeting hall
cards.notes: Walk over to see the building and check whether a current exhibition is open. Weekday-afternoon visits or an appointment are the published visitor options.
cards.short_summary: Add a historic arts stop to the campus loop.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH says Union Grove Gallery is a restored historic building used for art exhibitions, meetings, and events, and is open weekday afternoons and by appointment.
cards.source_title: Union Grove Gallery | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Visitor access is listed for weekday afternoons and by appointment; confirm the exhibition schedule.

cards.title: 6. Find the UAH Community Garden
cards.subtitle: Map-listed campus garden
cards.notes: Use the campus map to locate the garden, then look for Green Club information if you want to garden with others or ask about plot availability.
cards.short_summary: Identify a hands-on campus community resource.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH’s Green Club says students can garden with others or rent their own plot at the UAH Community Garden.
cards.source_title: Student Organizations | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Garden participation and plot availability should be confirmed with the Green Club.

cards.title: 7. Tour the University Fitness Center
cards.subtitle: UFC on the UAH campus map
cards.notes: Find the facility and note the indoor track, gymnasium, and group-fitness offerings. Bring your Charger Card and verify eligibility before planning a workout.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH’s University Fitness Center lists a gymnasium, indoor track, cardiovascular equipment, and group fitness classes.
cards.source_title: University Fitness Center | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Membership and facility access rules apply; verify current access requirements and hours before visiting.

cards.entity_name: Robert E. James Black Box Theatre
cards.title: 8. Put the Black Box Theatre on your map
cards.subtitle: Map-listed venue near Morton Hall
cards.notes: Walk by the Robert E. James Black Box Theatre and save its location for a future performance. Check UAH Theatre’s current calendar before attending.
cards.short_summary: Locate a named campus performance venue.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH’s campus map lists the Robert E. James Black Box Theatre as a campus destination.
cards.source_title: Campus Map | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Performance access, dates, and ticket requirements vary; consult the current event listing.

cards.title: 9. Find Charger Park for a future game
cards.subtitle: Map-listed athletics destination
cards.notes: Make a daylight walk to Charger Park and note the route from central campus. Use the athletics schedule later to choose an appropriate event to attend.
cards.short_summary: Add a named athletics destination to your mental map.
cards.evidence_claim: UAH’s campus map lists Charger Park as a campus destination.
cards.source_title: Campus Map | The University of Alabama in Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Facility access and event admission vary; check the current athletics schedule before returning.

cards.title: 10. If you have transportation, end at Big Spring Park
cards.subtitle: 200 Church Street, Huntsville
cards.notes: If you can travel there safely, finish with a daytime walk on the park’s walking path. Keep this as an optional off-campus stop rather than a required campus trip.
cards.evidence_claim: The City of Huntsville lists Big Spring Park at 200 Church Street with passive greenspace and a walking path.
cards.source_title: Find a Park | City of Huntsville
cards.access_notes: Plan transportation and visit during daylight; follow posted City park rules.
